text:
Alex: Heads up — staging promo is blocked, deploy-scheduler job failed during artifact fetch. Cache read errors + checksum mismatch, holding the cutover for now.

deploybot: Job deploybot/stage-promo-2026 failed (exit 64). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/4567 (artifact fetch error) :warning:

Maria: Can you paste the tail of the worker logs? or run `cictl fetch-logs`?

Alex: pasted logs below:
```
worker-12 | s3cache: read err: EIO reading object "artifacts/stage-promo/2026/model.tar.gz"
worker-12 | checksum: expected sha256=abc123... got def456...
worker-12 | http: 500 from blobstore on GET /artifacts/stage-promo/2026/model.tar.gz
worker-12 | error: artifact verify failed
```

Samir: Two quick options: 1) pin the promotion to last-known-good digest (sha256:abc123) and force promote (fast, but drops current changes) or 2) attempt a targeted cache prune + reupload and re-run pipeline (keeps changes if successful). My vote is targeted prune first since change window still open.

Olivia: Are there any DB migrations in this promo? don't want half migrations promoted then revert.

Samir: No DB changes in this release — it's model + frontend assets only. Safe to retry without migration risk.

Maria: Command to test prune in dry-run:
```bash
kubectl exec -n infra deploy-scheduler-0 -- /usr/local/bin/cache-prune --prefix "artifacts/stage-promo/2026" --dry-run
```
If that looks good, rerun without --dry-run which will remove stale/malformed objects.

Alex: I'll take the prune + rerun. Starting now, ETA ~20m. If prune doesn't clear it, I'll pin to sha256:abc123 and we promote.

oncall-bot: Note: change window open until 2026-10-14T18:00Z — proceeding with remediation during window.

deploybot: Replay triggered by Alex for job deploybot/stage-promo-2026 (attempt #3).

Alex: Prune finished: removed 12 stale objects, 3 partial multipart uploads aborted. Requeued the job.
```
prune: removed artifacts/stage-promo/2026/part-003.tmp
prune: removed artifacts/stage-promo/2026/old-meta.json
prune: aborted multipart uploads: 3
```

deploybot: Job deploybot/stage-promo-2026 passed all checks (smoke + integration). :tada:

Maria: Great — staging smoke passed. I'm preparing the promotion and will update release notes with the artifact digests. Heads-up to PMs in #product.

Samir: If we had needed fallback, remember to record pinned digest and rationale in the release notes. Also add a short postmortem for aborted multipart uploads causing EIO.

Olivia: Filing a short ticket to investigate S3 client retries and multipart cleanup TTLs. tagging infra and eng-sre.

Alex: Closing the hold, will run promote in 5m and add a note to the release changelog about transient cache corruption and the remediation steps taken.

Maria: :thumbsup: will coordinate the final promote and the PM notif after the promote completes.
